summary: Pass at 4330cb42. The week 1 version 2 delivery change is correct. The approval entry gains an optional integer fileVersion (>= 1) in zod; with it the writer replaces only the -v<n>.png suffix of both list names, and without it the v1 names, version, and bytes stay. The no-suffix refusal throws inside the first name-check loop before any read or write. Every check (schema, duplicates, list pin, names, bytes, symlink, different manifest) still runs before the first write. T184 to T189 each failed at Red (6 failed, 23 passed of 29), T189 reuses the existing different-manifest rule, and T152 to T172, T181, and T182 did not change. The Green evidence block in plan.md matches jr-green-v2-delivery.log: vitest exit 0 with 178 passed, tsc owned 0 of 38, and the fileVersion-ignore mutation failing T184. The four gate files hold 29 + 141 + 5 + 3 = 178 it() rows, which corroborates the 178 claim. Two nits remain: the no-suffix refusal has no test, and the mutation proof exists only as a summary line.

Name rewrite: deliveredNames at src/storytime/muse-delivery.ts:189-203. Without fileVersion it returns the plan names and deliveredVersion(row). With fileVersion it tests /-v\d+\.png$/ on both names and replaces only that suffix with `-v${fileVersion}.png`, so the row id and the -line- segment keep their exact bytes. Candidate fields use the new names: version, file, lineArt.file, and lineArt.colorFile at src/storytime/muse-delivery.ts:413-424; the review file fields for kimi and person reviews use colorFile at lines 280 and 310; the final copies use colorFile and lineFile at lines 455-456. For a v1 row the values equal row.fileName and row.lineArtFileName because planPictureRow returns those two at src/storytime/book-pictures.ts:1565, so the v1 path is byte-identical to the old code.

Refusal when the list name has no suffix: src/storytime/muse-delivery.ts:200 throws with the row id and the offending name. The call at line 366 sits in the first loop, before the read loop, the manifest compare, and the writes, so a refusal leaves the delivery folder unchanged. No test covers this branch (nonblocking finding RA-P3V2-1).

One candidate per job and no v1 file for a v2 row: the approval list refuses a repeated rowId at src/storytime/muse-delivery.ts:342-346, one DeliveryItem exists per row, and assembleManifest at src/storytime/book-pictures.ts:2079-2099 groups candidates by jobId and selects the newest ready version. The copies loop emits only the delivered names, so no v1 file is written for a v2 row. T185 at tests/storytime-muse-delivery.test.ts:1257 asserts one candidate, selectedVersion 2, the exact folder file list [v2Color, v2Line, manifest.json], an empty v1-name filter, and the v2 file names in the color and lineart batches. T187 at line 1332 asserts the mixed run writes the v2 row under the v2 name and no file under its v1 name.

Checks before the first write: schema parse at line 337, duplicate and unknown row checks at 340-349, list pin at 351-359, name checks including the suffix refusal at 362-382, structural problems collected before any write at 396-431, manifest compare at 443-450, per-copy lstat, symlink, and byte checks at 462-478, and the only writes at 483-486 with the wx flag. T188 at tests/storytime-muse-delivery.test.ts:1370 drives the CLI with fileVersion 0, -1, 2.5, and "2" and asserts exit 1, an empty delivery folder, and a refusal message that names fileVersion. T189 asserts the refused v2 run keeps the manifest bytes and writes no v2 file.

Unchanged rules: the f1e797cb diff shows the manifest lstat, symlink, different-manifest, and different-bytes blocks only as unchanged context; the copies changed names only. The --week filter lives in the deliver command of scripts/storytime-book-pictures.ts, and f1e797cb touched no other file, so the week rule and T182 are untouched. T181 and T182 sit at tests/storytime-muse-delivery.test.ts:1022 and 1083 unchanged.

Zod schema: fileVersion is z.number().int().min(1).optional() at src/storytime/muse-delivery.ts:69, inside the existing non-strict MuseApprovalEntrySchema. The schema refusal path is entries.0.fileVersion, which is the string T188 matches with /fileVersion/i.
